rounds.text: Srinibas Pradhan Constructions Ltd trades at a market price of ₹ 134 against a discounted cash flow intrinsic value of ₹ 165, leaving an explicit margin of safety of 18.6% [E27, E28]. Furthermore, a reverse DCF demonstrates that today's market price implies a modest earnings growth rate of just 7.1%, which sits well below the 10.0% assumed in the base case [E29]. The business exhibits exceptional capital efficiency, underscored by a filed ROCE of 31.0% and an ROE of 23.3% [E10, E11], significantly outperforming sector median ROCE benchmarks of 13.6% [E47]. Growth is also robust, demonstrated by compounded sales growth of 58% and compounded profit growth of 53% over the trailing twelve months [E12, E13]. Balance sheet risk is minimal as the company is almost debt free with a debt-to-equity ratio of just 0.04x and borrowings reduced to Rs 1.26 Cr [E22, E23, E32]. Conceded: operating cash flow is negative at Rs -6.67 Cr for Mar 2026, leading to a weak cash conversion ratio of -1.18x and increased working capital days [E18, E19, E36].
